metadata.title: Probing the shape of the Milky Way dark matter halo with hypervelocity stars: a new method

notes: No eligible individual stars are identifiable. T:p2-b8 describes the first HVS candidate only generically as “a B-type star” with no supported name or catalog identifier and does not analyze it; T:p2-b9 refers only to an aggregate of ∼70 literature HVS candidates without listing individual members; and T:p12-b5 states that the paper’s “observed sample” consists of synthetic mock HVSs, not identifiable real stars.
